verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a policy layer of funds and templates that restrict spend by amount, interval, merchant category, merchant and country, and says it applies across cards, reimbursements and bills. It adds approval workflows keyed to spend amount, team role, category or vendor type, plus context-aware travel per diem by location and duration. It also states that in-policy expenses are auto-approved while unclear or risky ones are escalated for human review. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring role-based limits and auto-approve rules (role mostly appears in notification routing), and independent or hands-on corroboration that exceptions-only routing works as marketed.
